pages.text: Altered from $(5)Protection$(), $(4)Vigor$() Increases max health per level. Maximum level is $(4)IV$() and it conflicts with $(5)Protection$(), $(5)Fire Protection$(), $(5)Blast Protection$(), $(5)Projectile Protection$() and $(4)Elemental Deviation$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: Vigor makes any armor act similarly to Skin Armor, becoming one with the user. The effect is a bit weaker than with Skin Armor and it locks out the possibility to combine the health increase with other 'protection enchantments'. It can still be a preferred choice for armors that have unique effects, such as the Sinner Robe pieces.
